Package com.monkey.ultimatebot.api.managers

Interface IBotManager

public interface IBotManager
Public service interface for creating, managing and removing UltimateBot instances.

This contract is intended for third-party plugins that integrate with UltimateBot. It supports both UUID-based operations and convenience parsing from string references.

      boolean isBotSpawned(UUID ownerUUID)
      Checks whether a bot is currently active for the given owner.

      For TEAM_ALLY bots, implementations may also return true for team members mapped to the same shared bot.

      Parameters:
      ownerUUID - owner UUID to check
      Returns:
      true if an active bot exists for the owner context

    • spawn

      BotOperationResult spawn(BotSpawnRequest request)
      Spawns a bot using a fully structured spawn request.

      On success, the returned result contains a snapshot of the spawned bot.

      Parameters:
      request - validated request describing mode, owners, targets and settings
      Returns:
      operation result with success flag, message and optional snapshot

    • spawnByReferences

      BotOperationResult spawnByReferences(com.monkey.ultimatebot.common.model.BotMode mode, @Nullable String ownerReference, @Nullable Collection<String> targetReferences, @Nullable Collection<String> teamOwnerReferences, @Nullable BotSettings settings)
      Spawns a bot by parsing player references (name/UUID strings).

      This is a convenience overload for command-like integrations where player identifiers are provided as strings.

      Parameters:
      mode - bot mode to spawn
      ownerReference - owner reference (name or UUID string), may be null for TEAM_ALLY
      targetReferences - target references (name or UUID strings), may be null
      teamOwnerReferences - team owner references for TEAM_ALLY, may be null
      settings - spawn settings; when null, implementation-defined defaults may be used
      Returns:
      operation result with success flag and details

    • parsePlayerReference

      Optional<UUID> parsePlayerReference(String playerReference)
      Parses a single player reference into an online UUID.

      Implementations commonly support exact name, fuzzy name and UUID string parsing, but usually resolve only online players.

      Parameters:
      playerReference - player name or UUID string
      Returns:
      resolved UUID when parsing succeeds and player is available, otherwise empty

    • parsePlayerReferences

      Map<String,UUID> parsePlayerReferences(Collection<String> playerReferences)
      Parses a collection of player references into UUID mappings.

      Entries that cannot be resolved are omitted from the returned map.

      Parameters:
      playerReferences - collection of references to parse
      Returns:
      map reference -> uuid containing only successfully resolved entries

    • updateTotems

      boolean updateTotems(UUID ownerUUID, int totemCount)
      Updates the current totem count for a managed bot.

      The update can fail when the bot does not exist, the setting is locked, or the provided value is outside the allowed configured range.

      Parameters:
      ownerUUID - owner UUID
      totemCount - desired totem count
      Returns:
      true if update was applied

      int removeAll()
      Removes all currently active bots and returns how many were tracked before cleanup.

      This is the preferred API method for integrations that need an explicit "remove all" operation. despawnAll() remains available as a void alias.

      number of bots that were active before removal
